notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621886/aff759e634bb48a5dbada697b13e0a94e855e670.png"]Thank you sooooo much to everyone who played the game.
I am a solo game developer, so I apologize for any bad parts of the game.

I looked at all the videos about the game on YouTube and fixed some bugs that I missed and improved the gameplay a little.

Garbage bags bug fixed

Auto game save added

Added \[K] and \[U] buttons for quiting game and delete save progress

Continue button added to the menu at the start of the game



I have started working on a new game now, and this time the story will shock you even more. Thank you very much again.
